name: Algebra 1 Recurring + Assessment Resource Profile
role: Course-specific Warm-Up / Exit / Progress / Review / Summative behavior. Shared PMs own procedure and rendering mechanics; this profile owns Algebra-specific behavior.

warmups.days_rule: Build three daily Warm-Ups per section by default unless the current teacher request/calendar explicitly changes the count.
warmups.architecture: Every daily Algebra Warm-Up uses four stable jobs: Q1 Solve / Equation Fluency, Q2 Diamond / Factoring Pattern, Q3 Skill Review, Q4 Challenge.
warmups.question_structure_exception: Warm-Ups do not use the universal Question Structure requirement.
warmups.calculator_language: For fraction/integer fluency, encourage trying without a calculator first while clearly allowing calculator use if needed.

graphics.diamond_rule: Every visual diamond problem must be generated by the registered graph tool. No handmade SVG/CSS/HTML diamonds.

viewer.purpose: Fast screen-first scan of all Unit Warm-Ups.

freshness.rule: Stable routines and fresh value-set parallels are allowed. Exact repeated finished questions or exact copies of current student-facing prompts are repaired.

new_evidence.ticket_a_rule: Use fresh instances of the section's two mapped current Mastery evidence jobs.
new_evidence.ticket_b_rule: Use fresh second opportunities on the SAME two mapped section evidence jobs; do not invent different section targets.

rolling_reassessment.next_section_rule: Next section Ticket A reassesses previous section Ticket B N1/N2.
rolling_reassessment.cross_unit_rule: Unit N Section 1 Ticket A reassesses Unit N-1 Section 5 Ticket B N1/N2 from the prior EXIT_INSTANCE_MAP.json.

u1_1_exception.ticket_a: Use four opening evidence jobs; first pair is N1/N2, second pair is opening_new in R1/R2 positions.
u1_1_exception.ticket_b: N1/N2 are fresh second opportunities on designated U1.1 new pair; R1/R2 reassess U1.1 Ticket A N1/N2.

same_day_print_versions.purpose: Same-day anti-copy forms with the same evidence blueprint and rotated visible positions.

exit_tickets.instructional_parallel_rule: Straightforward new-evidence questions may use fresh number/data parallels from familiar instructional structures. Exact copies are forbidden; distinctive surfaces should vary another meaningful axis when practical.
exit_tickets.reassessment_parallel_rule: Exit-to-Exit reassessment preserves same target and same family by default. Fresh number/data/value swaps are explicitly acceptable and often preferred.

viewer.grouping: Section -> Ticket A -> four canonical screen cards; Ticket B -> four canonical screen cards

exit_tickets.layout: Unit index with Ticket A and Ticket B links per section; canonical screen ticket uses 2x2 four-question layout; print/collect renders four same-day versions.
exit_tickets.evidence_map_cadence_note: Use evidence-map allocations; legacy one-ticket-per-section cadence prose is superseded by this current profile/PM.

freshness.new_evidence_override: Clean number/data parallels may pass for straightforward procedural/direct tasks.
freshness.reassessment_override: Same family/structure plus fresh values/data is expected and may pass because comparability is the purpose.
freshness.same_day_versions_rule: All four versions use fresh sibling instances; exact sibling duplicates fail.

progress_tracker.organization: Mastery Goal -> supporting exact I Can statements -> portfolio evidence -> current evidence status -> next move

review.target_rule: Unit Review prepares the CURRENT Unit Mastery Goals/supporting I Cans and does not mean the Section Spiral Review stage.

summative.source_rule: Render the six secure canonical Bank forms authored under the accepted Summative blueprint. Do not regenerate them downstream.
summative.evidence_rule: Target approximately two secure evidence opportunities per CURRENT Unit Mastery Goal.
summative.time_rule: Design each full form for about a 40-minute class period.

targeted_reteach_check.targets: Intro, Review, misconception, or recently retaught skill
targeted_reteach_check.canonical_status: Not automatically an official Exit Ticket, Bank requirement, or portfolio event.
